Humphrey''' (born July 24, 1979) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player, at the [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]] position. Humphrey is currently an assistant basketball coach at The University of Oklahoma. Previously he was a coach at [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball|Notre Dame]].{{Cite web|url=https://soonersports.com/staff-directory/ryan-humphrey/302|title=Ryan Humphrey|publisher=SoonerSports.com|access-date=June 29, 2023}} After a college career at both the [[University of Oklahoma]] and the [[University of Notre Dame]], Humphrey was a first-round pick of the [[Utah Jazz]] in the [[2002 NBA draft]]. On draft day, he was traded to the [[Orlando Magic]] in exchange for their pick, [[Curtis Borchardt]]. After appearing in 1/2 season with Orlando, Humphrey was traded to the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] alongside [[Mike Miller (basketball, born 1980)|Mike Miller]] in exchange for [[Drew Gooden (basketball)|Drew Gooden]] and [[Gordan Giriček]]. He played only 2 games during the [[2003-04 NBA season|2003–04]] season and then played 35 games for Memphis during the [[2004-05 NBA season|2004–05]] season. Humphrey's final NBA game was on March 16, 2005, in a 88–82 win over the [[New Orleans Hornets]] where he recorded 2 points and 1 rebound. Humphrey played a total of 85 career games from 2002 to 2005 and averaged 2.3 points and 2.2 rebounds. After a failed return attempt with the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] ([[2005-06 NBA season|2005-06's preseason]]), Humphrey moved to the [[Serie A (basketball)|Italian league]], with [[Pallacanestro Reggiana|Bipop Carire Reggio Emilia]]. He signed with the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] in September 2006 but was waived in late October, also before the league's tip-off.[https://www.espn.com/nba/news/story?id=2639929 Second stint with Clippers cut short, Murray waived], Oct. 26 2006 He later signed with [[APOEL B.C.]] in [[Cyprus]], with whom he reached the 2007 [[Cyprus Basketball Division 1|Cypriot league finals]]. In 2009, he arrived in Spain and played with [[Baloncesto León]] in the [[Liga Española de Baloncesto|LEB Oro]]. In 2010, he signed with [[Cáceres Ciudad del Baloncesto|Cáceres 2016]]. On April 4, 2013, he signed with [[CB Valladolid|Blancos de Rueda Valladolid]].{{cite web|title=CB Valladolid signs Ryan
